tokens.v: A planned order is a proposal that no other module can see. Confirming marks it approved, and transferring translates it: a planned production order becomes a production order in Job Shop Control and a planned purchase order becomes a purchase order in Procurement, decided by the item's supply source. A transfer run against unconfirmed orders appears to do nothing.
